stock.description: Huzhou Gas Co., Ltd. engages in distributing piped natural gas and liquefied natural gas in the People’s Republic of China. It constructs and installs end-user pipeline network and gas facilities for property developers, owners, and occupants of residential and non-residential properties. The company also sells household gas appliances and relevant equipment, energy, and distributed photovoltaic power. In addition, it provides leasing of properties; and solar power generation technology services, solar thermal power generation equipment and photovoltaic equipment. Huzhou Gas Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Huzhou, the People’s Republic of China.
